rv.q: Lynn Nottage’s powerful drama of rust-belt decline demands a more urgent staging
Although Nottage creates a satisfying tragic structure as the pieces converge in a more gripping second half, it’s effortful to get there.
Arguably carried more by the talent of actors as opposed to direction, Sweat is a must-see performance with timeless relevance.

cn.t: Nottage's Pulitzer Prize-winning drama receives praise for its powerful depiction of American deindustrialization and fractured relationships, brought to life through immersive staging at the Royal Exchange Theatre.
